name: Theme Switch Hero
description: Full-screen hero headline framed by hairline grid lines with a moon/sun toggle that switches light and dark themes using a circular view-transition reveal, plus a spinning textured accent word.
contents: Headline with gradient text and a textured accent word
Framed section with crossing grid lines and corner dots
Fixed moon/sun theme toggle at top center
behavior: Toggle expands a circular clip-path reveal from the toggle using the View Transitions API, with plain switch fallback
Initial theme follows system preference when enabled

props.name: accentTexture
props.default: repeating-conic-gradient(from var(--texture-angle) at 50% 80%, #ffffff 0 6deg, transparent 6deg 18deg), repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 50% 80%, #ffffff 0 2px, transparent 2px 14px)

editableByProps: Headline words, accent texture and spin speed
Default theme and system preference use
All light and dark theme colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the toggle size or position
Change the reveal shape or easing

fixed: Root is a full-viewport section with min-h-[100dvh] that centers its content
Toggle is fixed to the top center of the viewport
Injects global view-transition CSS for the root while mounted
Uses the Instrument Sans font via next/font/google, requires Next.js
